title: Service-Fee Share Rate Basis by Service Level — Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Service-fee share rate basis by service level (Cartwise Grocery Orders)

**Rule.** On Cartwise Grocery Orders, the fee share is worked out according to how the service fee was billed. When the order carries a waiver from the member service-fee rate and the service fee billed is above the service level's service-fee floor, the share is the service fee before the member saving (the fee billed plus that waiver) times the fee-share refund basis divided by the item subtotal. When the order carries no such waiver and the fee billed is above the floor, the share is the fee-share refund basis times the service level's non-member service-fee rate. When the service fee billed is not above the floor, this rule does not change how the share is worked out.

"Above the floor" is strict: a fee billed exactly at the floor is not above it.

## Floor and rate by service level

| Service level | Service-fee floor (USD) | Non-member service-fee rate |
|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | 0.99 | 2.5 percent |
| No-Rush Delivery | 2.00 | 5 percent |
| Standard Delivery | 3.00 | 7.5 percent |
| Priority Delivery | 3.00 | 7.5 percent |
| Express 30 Delivery | 3.00 | 7.5 percent |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 3.00 | 7.5 percent |

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Judgement | Fee share before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Priority Delivery; fee billed 3.60; member service-fee rate waiver 1.20; item subtotal 64.00; basis 9.00 | Waiver present, 3.60 is above 3.00 | 4.80 times 9.00 divided by 64.00, that is 0.675 |
| No-Rush Delivery; fee billed 2.40; no waiver; basis 9.00 | No waiver, 2.40 is above 2.00 | 9.00 times 5 percent, that is 0.45 |
| No-Rush Delivery; fee billed 2.00; no waiver | 2.00 is not above 2.00 | Not changed by this rule |
| Standard Delivery; fee billed 3.01; no waiver; basis 10.00 | 3.01 is above 3.00 | 10.00 times 7.5 percent, that is 0.75 |

The member service-fee rate waiver is the fee waiver entry recorded on the order at checkout for the difference between the non-member and the member service fee.
